name: Melilla
summary: A light blue field with the arms of Melilla, including the arms of the Dukes of Medina Sidonia, whose forces took the city in 1497.
origin: Melilla was taken by the Duke of Medina Sidonia in 1497. It became an autonomous city in 1995.

symbols.name: City arms
symbols.description: Arms with the Pillars of Hercules and Guzmán family symbols.
symbols.meaning: The city's conquest and Spanish sovereignty.

facts: Melilla is a Spanish city in North Africa, bordering Morocco.
Morocco claims both Ceuta and Melilla.
clues: A light blue field with a city coat of arms.
A Spanish city on the North African coast taken in 1497.
